contested_thread: E6 oracle-determinism (recurred ~15 of last ~25 rounds without terminating)
scoping_question: Is residual E6 perfect-determinism a plan-authorization blocker or an Argo implementation-spike (bounded honest-limit per repo proposal-lifecycle precedent)?

verdict.rationale: The fundamental requirement that oracles be deterministic and discriminating is enforceable in principle through alternative mechanisms, such as WASM sandboxing or coarse multi-evaluation agreement checks. The specific difficulty of perfectly isolating arbitrary Node.js runtimes from vDSO and libc non-determinism using seccomp is a platform engineering challenge, not a conceptual flaw in the plan itself. Consistent with repository precedent, this mechanism proof can be safely bounded as an honest limit and deferred to implementation, provided a clear detection fallback is specified.
verdict.required_plan_text_if_spike: HONEST LIMIT - E6 Perfect Oracle Determinism: While the plan requires normative oracles to be discriminating, perfectly isolating arbitrary black-box Node.js oracles from all runtime/vDSO non-determinism channels via pre-execution seccomp is out of scope for the authorization plan. RESOLUTION PATH: This will be addressed as an Argo implementation spike to evaluate alternative sandboxing strategies, such as restricted pure-evaluator ABIs (e.g., WASM), specialized deterministic execution harnesses, or coarse-grained runtime checks. DETECTION FALLBACK: Until strict isolation is implemented, the system will enforce a coarse 'same-input-multiple-eval' agreement check-running the oracle repeatedly with identical inputs under randomized concealing schedules-and will instantly fail any oracle exhibiting output variance, flagging the run for manual governance review.

disposition: Non-convergence escalated to the Gemini referee per the standing 'no-cap-referee' directive. Referee ruled argo-implementation-spike; its prescribed honest-limit text is folded into candidate-approach.md E6, replacing the escalating perfect-determinism mechanism claims. Workshop re-runs on the folded candidate.
post_ruling_resolution: Ruling applied by COMMITTING to a restricted pure-evaluator oracle ABI (pure function over a fixed input snapshot; no ambient clock/entropy/network/fs), making determinism STRUCTURAL rather than an isolation problem. Soundness is now settled IN-PLAN; only the ABI's implementation FORM (WASM component vs frozen-realm Node worker) remains the bounded Argo spike.
